# dtcloud_security_groups (Data Source)

Lists the security groups visible to the caller.

The list endpoint reports an id, a name and a description, and nothing else. Rules would be one more
call per group, so read a group with `dtcloud_security_group` when you need them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dtcloud_security_groups" "all" {}

data "dtcloud_security_groups" "named_web" {
  name = "web-tier"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only return security groups with this exact name. Names are not unique, so this can still match several.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ids` (List of String) Just the ids, for the common case of filling a VM interface's `security_groups`, which takes ids.
- `security_groups` (List of Object) The security groups that matched. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--security_groups))

<a id="nestedatt--security_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `security_groups`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)

## Behaviour worth knowing

* **`name` is applied by the provider**, since the list route takes no query parameters, and it can
  still match several groups.
* **`ids` follows the order of `security_groups`.** For one specific group, look it up with the
  `dtcloud_security_group` data source rather than indexing into the list.
